Run and export a pipeline

Source: R/pipeline.R
export_pipeline.Rd

Convenience wrapper that runs pipeline() and writes the result using export_csv().

Usage

export_pipeline(
  in_path,
  mode = "ml_ready",
  out_path,
  export_sep = ";",
  report_path = NULL,
  report_stats = NULL,
  load_fun = read_raw_csv,
  load_args = list(),
  ...
)

Arguments

in_path

Path to the raw CSV file.

mode

Pipeline mode (see pipeline()).

out_path

Destination path (directory + file name) for the cleaned CSV.

export_sep

Separator used for writing (default ";").

report_path

Optional path to write a cleaning report (text file).

report_stats

Optional named list of stats to include in the report.

load_fun

Function used to load the raw file (default read_raw_csv).

load_args

Named list of arguments forwarded to load_fun.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to pipeline().

Value

The cleaned data.frame (invisibly), after writing it to disk.
